text: Based on the evidence, no significant deforestation occurred on this asset after 2020. The assessment shows "NOT_DETECTED" for tree-cover loss from 2021 to 2025. While there were small patches of loss under 0.5 ha in 2021, these are not counted as events. The latest observations confirm no substantial tree-cover change within the asset boundary during the specified period. Thus, the asset remained free of significant deforestation post-2020.
